title: A Bit of Kindness
lines: Rosa was in the yard when the rain came.
She ran for the shed to get out of it.
Then she heard a small sound by the fence.
A pup sat there, wet and cold in the grass.
It had no tag on and it was thin.
Rosa took it in and got it dry.
She fed it and it went to sleep on the rug.
"That was kindness," said her mom.
Rosa was hopeful the pup had a home.
First she went to each house on her road.
She knocked at each door, but no one had lost a pup.
That was a big sadness for Rosa.
Then she had a helpful plan of her own.
Rosa made a sign with a big red pup on it.
Dad helped her tape it to the pole by the shop.
The next day a girl came up the path.
She was thankful and her eyes went wide.
"That is my pup, Sam!" she yelled.
Sam ran to her and jumped up.
She held out a reward, but Rosa said no.
"Just come back to play," said Rosa.
Now Rosa and Sam play in the yard each week.

questions.ask: Where did Rosa find the pup?
questions.listenFor: In the yard by the fence, wet and cold in the rain. The first four lines help.

questions.ask: What did Rosa try before she made the sign?
questions.listenFor: She knocked at each house on her road, but no one had lost a pup.

questions.ask: Would you have taken the reward? Why?
questions.listenFor: There is no right answer here. Listen for a reason that fits the story.
